<module id="float_multi">
	<description>A module to implement 32-bit floating point multiplier according to IEEE 754 standard. The inputs and outputs should be in IEEE 754 format.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">clock signal</input>
		<input id="rst">reset signal</input>
		
		<input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">IEEE 754 representation of number A.</input>
		<input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">IEEE 754 representation of number B.</input>
		
		<output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">IEEE 754 representation of product of A and B.</output>
	endports
	
	<parameter_description>
		<!-- Add any parameters used in your design here -->
	endparameter_description
	
	<logic_description type="sequential_logic">
		reg [2:0] counter;
		reg [23:0] a_mantissa,b_mantissa,z_mantissa;
		reg [9:0] a_exponent,b_exponent,z_exponent;
		reg a_sign,b_sign,z_sign;
		reg guard_bit,round_bit,sticky;
		reg [49:0]product;
	endlogic_description
	
	<implementation>
		assign z[22:0] = z_mantissa;
		assign z[30:23] = z_exponent[7:0];
		assign z[31] = z_sign;
		always @(posedge clk) begin
			if(rst==1'b1)begin
				counter <= 3'd0;
			end else begin
				case(counter)
					//First cycle: extract a_mantissa,a_exponent,a_sign,b_mantissa,b_exponent,b_sign
					0:begin
						a_mantissa[23] <= 1'b1;
						b_mantissa[23] <= 1'b1;
						a_exponent <= {1'b0,a[30:23]};
						b_exponent <= {1'b0,b[30:23]};
						a_sign <= a[31];
						b_sign <= b[31];
						product <= 49'b0;
						counter <= counter + 1'b1;
					end
					
					//Second cycle: check special cases: NAN, INF, Zero
					1:begin
						if((a_exponent == 10'h1ff && a_mantissa != 0)||(b_exponent == 10'h1ff && b_mantissa != 0))begin //NAN case
							z_exponent <= 8'hff;
							z_mantissa <= 23'h1;
							z_sign <= 1'b0;
						end else if(a_exponent == 10'h1ff || b_exponent == 10'h1ff)begin //INF case
							z_exponent <= 10'h1ff;
							z_mantissa <= 23'h0;
							z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
						end else if(a[30:0]==0||b[30:0]==0)begin //Zero Case
							z_exponent <= 10'h0;
							z_mantissa <= 23'h0;
							z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
						end else begin
							product <= {{(a_exponent)},a_mantissa} * {{(b_exponent)},b_mantissa};
							z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent;
							z_sign <= a_sign^b_sign;
							counter <= counter+1'b1;
						end
					end
					
					//Third cycle: normalize a_mantissa,b_mantissa
					2:begin
						if(product[49])begin //if msb of product is one
							a_mantissa <= product[48:25]; //shift right by 1 bit
							b_mantissa <= product[24:3];
							z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1'b1;
						end else begin //otherwise left-shift
							a_mantissa <= product[47:24]; //shift right by 1 bit
							b_mantissa <= product[23:2];
							guard_bit <= product[1];
							round_bit <= product[0];
							sticky <= product[23:2]|guard_bit|round_bit;
							counter <= counter+1'b1;
						end
					end
				
					//Fourth cycle: multiply mantissa
					3:begin
						product <= a_mantissa*b_mantissa;
						z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1'b1;
						counter <= counter + 1'b1;
					end
					
					//Fifth cycle: Round
					4:begin
						if(guard_bit&(round_bit|sticky|z_mantissa[0]))begin
							z_mantissa <= z_mantissa+1'b1;
							if(z_mantissa==23'hffffff)begin
								z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1'b1;
							end
						end
						counter <= counter + 1'b1;
					end
					
					//Sixth cycle: handle overflow & underflow
					5:begin
						if(z_exponent >= 10'h1fe)begin //Overflow
							z_exponent <= 10'h1ff;
							z_mantissa <= 23'h0;
							z_sign <= a_sign^b_sign;
						end else if(z_exponent<=10'h01&&z_mantissa!=23'h0)begin //Underflow
							z_exponent <= 10'h00;
							z_mantissa <= 23'h0;
							z_sign <= a_sign^b_sign;
						end
						
						counter</implementation></logic_description></parameter_description></ports></module>
